statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The patient has diagnosis codes I47.1 and I25.10
The denial reason code is CO-197
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The claim was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
